description:
Search Gmarket, one of Korea's largest online marketplaces, right inside ChatGPT. Ask the way you normally would, such as "recommend a birthday gift for my girlfriend", "a wireless mouse under 30,000 won", or "iPhone 16 case", and compare the matching products in a swipeable card view with images, prices, discounts, star ratings, review counts, seller, and shipping details.

Refine as you chat. Search again with more specific keywords, set a price range, or ask to compare a few alternatives and get a separate set of results for each. Each search shows up to 10 products, and the "전체보기" (View all) link on the cards takes you to the full results on Gmarket. When you find the right one, tap the card to complete your purchase on Gmarket.

Gmarket offers a wide selection across fashion, beauty, home appliances, electronics, groceries, home & living, and more.

defaultPrompt: 게이밍 모니터 추천해주고, 추천 이유를 알려줘.
